description: Klassifiziertes Straßennetz Land M-V is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by strassenbauverwaltung.mvnet.de. The data set is available for the public roads of the road classes Autobahn, Bundesstraße, Landesstraße, Europastraßen which are located within the state of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. It is operated by the state of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, state office for road construction and transport. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Classified road network Country M-V" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Bundesautobahnen, überörtliche Straßen, Kreisstraßen, Bundesstraßen, Transport networks, Straßennetz. The listing shows 1 download or service links in SHP. The listing shows 2025-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
